title: RecipeProof
description: The CK/CM PROOF + TRUST binding: it turns a runnable recipe execution into a portable, reproducible, citable proof carrying a trust attestation. A RecipeProof REFERENCES a recipe by id (crystal-atlas internal-model register, PR #1287 — soft reference, binding activates when the register lands) and binds it to (a) a reproduced headline metric, (b) a SHA-256 hash-chained receipt on the repro-ledger spine (from tools/reproduce_bench.py, #1269), (c) a division verdict (open/closed, #1271 validate-submission), and (d) a trust attestation (clean-eval + provider-neutrality + no-laundering — the same estate gates). A third party VERIFIES a RecipeProof independently: chain intact + metric within epsilon + division/trust gates pass + recipe_ref resolvable. SHA-256 is the FIPS 180-4 algorithm (via stdlib hashlib), NOT a FIPS 140-validated module.

recipe_ref.description: Soft reference to a recipe in the crystal-atlas register (PR #1287, OPEN). recipe_id follows the register's id contract; content_digest is OPTIONAL and, when present, must match the register entry's content address once the register is available. Until the register lands on main, resolution is deferred (pending_register) — the reference is format-checked but not bound.

content_digest.description: OPTIONAL SHA-256 content address of the resolved register entry (FIPS 180-4 algorithm).

repro_ledger_ref.description: Pointer into the append-only repro-ledger spine emitted by reproduce_bench.py.

ledger_path.description: Repo-relative path to the repro-ledger JSONL (e.g. build/reproduce/isota/repro-ledger.jsonl).

receipt_ref.description: The SHA-256 entry_digest of the spine record on the repro-ledger that carries this run. The receipt is hash-chained (prev_entry_digest links each record to its predecessor); tampering breaks the chain.

value.description: The reproduced headline value bound by this proof.

epsilon.description: Declared tolerance; REQUIRED for bounded_nondeterministic (exact match for deterministic).

division.description: MLPerf-parity division (#1271). CLOSED = strict apples-to-apples; OPEN = novel methods, not directly comparable.

submission.description: The submission descriptor consumed by tools/validate_submission.py (#1271). The verifier runs the division gates over THIS descriptor; nothing here re-implements a gate.

trust_attestation.description: The trust binding. These three gates are ALWAYS required for a RecipeProof to verify, independent of division: clean-eval certificate, provider-neutrality, no-laundering. Verified by re-running the estate gates over `submission` — the attestation asserts, the verifier proves.

clean_eval.description: Asserts a pre-run contamination/clean-eval certificate with status 'clean'.

provider_neutrality.description: Asserts scoring carries no provider term (scored by our runner).

no_laundering.description: Asserts every headline fact is reproduced-by-us, disjoint from cited provider numbers.

doi_ref.description: OPTIONAL citable identity. concept_doi is the stable identity (latest version); version_doi is bound to this immutable proof. Minted via the DataCite concept/version client (#1267); referenced here, not minted here.
